description: Archive iOS schemes and upload them to App Store Connect / TestFlight with xcodebuild.

deploy.description: Archive each scheme (Release, generic iOS) into Xcode's Archives folder, then export and upload it to App Store Connect. Runs with a system-only PATH so Homebrew rsync can't break the export.

args.name: container
args.description: Absolute path to the .xcworkspace (CocoaPods projects) or .xcodeproj

args.name: schemes
args.description: One or more scheme names, space separated
